CareerAssessment.title: CareerAssessment
CareerAssessment.description: Private job seeker profile evaluation test responses and calculated readiness report

careerPreferences.description: Section D: Career goals and preferences

practicalAnswers.description: Section F: Multiple-choice answers keyed by question ID

learningRecommendationConsent.description: Consent to use responses for course recommendations

recruitmentConsent.description: Explicit optional opt-in for recruitment review

report.description: Calculated Career Readiness Report upon submission

LearningCourse.title: LearningCourse
LearningCourse.description: Admin-managed Learn with ABHI course metadata, unlock rules, and publication status

sequentialUnlock.description: Whether modules unlock sequentially upon passing module quizzes

updatedBy.description: Admin UID who last updated the course

CourseModule.title: CourseModule
CourseModule.description: Ordered module belonging to a Learn with ABHI course

quizRequired.description: Whether passing this module's quiz is required to unlock the next module

CourseLessonContent.title: CourseLessonContent
CourseLessonContent.description: Admin-managed lesson content, embedded YouTube video items, written material, exercise, and attachments for a Learn with ABHI course

videoUrl.description: Optional legacy/primary HTTPS embedded video URL

videos.description: Bounded ordered list of YouTube video metadata objects (max 10)

attachments.description: Bounded list of downloadable resource objects (max 15)

updatedBy.description: Admin UID who last updated the lesson

CourseQuizConfig.title: CourseQuizConfig
CourseQuizConfig.description: Admin-only quiz and final assessment configuration including answer keys and explanations

moduleId.description: Target module ID for module quizzes

questionCount.description: Number of questions served per attempt (1-30)

requiredForCompletion.description: Whether passing is required to complete course

CourseEnrolment.title: CourseEnrolment
CourseEnrolment.description: Candidate enrolment, sequential unlock state, and learning progress record for a Learn with ABHI course, keyed by courseId to prevent duplicates

currentModuleId.description: Last viewed module ID for resuming

currentLessonId.description: Last viewed lesson ID for resuming

completedLessonIds.description: Bounded list of completed lesson IDs (max 200)

completedModuleIds.description: Bounded list of completed module IDs (max 40)

passedModuleQuizIds.description: Bounded list of module IDs whose required quizzes are passed (max 40)

lastVerifiedAttemptId.description: Most recent passing module_quiz attempt document ID

finalAssessmentPassed.description: Whether the final course assessment was passed at or above pass threshold

bestFinalScorePercent.description: Highest final assessment score percentage achieved (0-100)

lastAccessedAt.description: Server timestamp of last lesson access or progress save

completedAt.description: ISO timestamp when all lessons, required quizzes, and final assessment passed

VideoProgress.title: VideoProgress
VideoProgress.description: Per-student, per-YouTube-video playback tracking record bound strictly to authenticated Firebase UID

maxPercentWatched.description: Highest percentage reached during real playback (0-100)

hasPlayed.description: True only after player begins real playback; never set on page load

completedViaPlayer.description: True only when hasPlayed is true and maxPercentWatched >= 80

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last playback sync

AssessmentAttempt.title: AssessmentAttempt
AssessmentAttempt.description: Immutable private server-graded quiz or final assessment attempt belonging strictly to an authenticated candidate

assessmentTitle.description: Display title of the quiz or final assessment

passed.description: Whether attempt met or exceeded passPercentage

answers.description: Map of questionId to selected option index (0-3)

questionResults.description: Post-submission graded review items with explanations (max 30)

CourseCertificate.title: CourseCertificate
CourseCertificate.description: Course Completion Certificate issued via preserved server_hmac flow or interim admin_approved flow. Keyed by courseId under /users/{userId}/certificates/{courseId} to prevent duplicates.

candidateName.description: Candidate full name printed on certificate

finalAssessmentScore.description: Verified final assessment percentage score (70-100 for server_hmac; optional 0-100 for admin_approved)

finalAttemptId.description: Document ID of the passing final_assessment attempt (required for server_hmac)

templateId.description: Certificate template ID used to render this credential

issuanceMethod.description: Distinguishes legacy/future server HMAC issuance from Starter-tier Admin-Approved issuance

approvedBy.description: Admin UID who approved issuance (required for admin_approved)

approvalNote.description: Optional admin review note for admin-approved issuance

verificationSignature.description: Backend HMAC integrity signature (required for server_hmac; omitted for admin_approved)

PublicCertificateVerification.title: PublicCertificateVerification
PublicCertificateVerification.description: Minimal public verification record keyed by certificateId. Strictly excludes email, phone, assessment answers, and personal profile data.

issuanceMethod.description: Optional transparent indicator of server_hmac vs admin_approved issuance

CertificateTemplate.title: CertificateTemplate
CertificateTemplate.description: Admin-managed branding and layout template metadata for Learn with ABHI Course Completion Certificates

isDefault.description: Whether this is the default platform template

updatedBy.description: Admin UID who last updated the template

AdminRole.title: AdminRole
AdminRole.description: Authoritative 5-role RBAC assignment keyed by Firebase Auth UID. Provisioned manually for initial Super Admin and managed strictly by active super_admin accounts.

status.description: Role activation status (use revoked instead of delete)

assignedBy.description: Super Admin UID who granted or updated the role

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last status or role change

AdminActivityLog.title: AdminActivityLog
AdminActivityLog.description: Server-written tamper-proof audit log schema. Client writes are strictly denied in firestore.rules until a trusted backend or Cloud Functions is enabled.

actorUid.description: UID of the admin who triggered the server action

actorRole.description: Active admin role at execution time

PlatformMetrics.title: PlatformMetrics
PlatformMetrics.description: Admin-only platform metric snapshot documents (Starter tier uses live getCountFromServer aggregations plus optional Super Admin snapshots; automated rollups wait for Cloud Functions).

id.description: Metric snapshot ID (e.g., latest or YYYY-MM-DD)

generatedBy.description: Super Admin UID or system identifier

CandidateProfile.title: CandidateProfile
CandidateProfile.description: Private full candidate profile containing personal contact information and career details. Strictly unreadable by unauthenticated visitors or other candidates.

expectedSalary.description: Private expected compensation range object (max 5 keys)

dob.description: Optional private date of birth ISO string

primaryResumeId.description: Optional ID of candidate's primary structured resume

CandidateDirectoryEntry.title: CandidateDirectoryEntry
CandidateDirectoryEntry.description: Split-collection non-PII candidate discovery summary readable strictly by verified employers and recruitment/super admins. Never stores email, phone, DOB, salary expectations, or resume files.

availableForOpportunities.description: Explicit opt-in flag for verified employer discovery

CandidateResume.title: CandidateResume
CandidateResume.description: Private structured JSON resume built by a candidate under /users/{userId}/resumes/{resumeId}. Strictly owner-only; zero public or employer access.

SavedJob.title: SavedJob
SavedJob.description: Private candidate saved job bookmark keyed by jobId

RecentlyViewedJob.title: RecentlyViewedJob
RecentlyViewedJob.description: Private candidate recently viewed job reference keyed by jobId

EmployerProfile.title: EmployerProfile
EmployerProfile.description: Company profile document. Publicly readable ONLY when verificationStatus == 'verified'. Recruiter personal email/phone PII is isolated in /employers/{employerId}/private_contacts/{contactId}.

id.description: Employer document ID (equals ownerUid for self-registered employers)

socialLinks.description: Bounded map of public social links (max 6 keys)

EmployerPrivateContact.title: EmployerPrivateContact
EmployerPrivateContact.description: Split-collection private recruiter contact details and verification notes under /employers/{employerId}/private_contacts/{contactId}. Strictly unreadable publicly.

verificationNotes.description: Optional business registration or verification notes

JobPosting.title: JobPosting
JobPosting.description: Job listing document. Publicly readable ONLY when status == 'published'. Candidates have zero write access; counters and verification/featured flags cannot be modified by employers.

employerOwnerUid.description: Denormalized immutable employer owner UID for O(1) rule enforcement

salary.description: Salary range map (min, max, currency, period)

applicantsCount.description: Admin/server-only metric (0 on create; never candidate-writable)

viewsCount.description: Admin/server-only metric (0 on create; never candidate-writable)

isVerifiedCompany.description: Verified company badge flag (requires verified employer or recruitment_admin)

postedAt.description: Server timestamp of publication or creation

JobApplication.title: JobApplication
JobApplication.description: Candidate job application document. Strictly readable by the applicant, the owning employer, and recruitment/super admins. Recruiter internal notes live in /applications/{applicationId}/internal_notes/{noteId}.

employerId.description: Target employer ID (verified against parent job on create)

employerOwnerUid.description: Denormalized immutable employer owner UID (verified against parent job on create)

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last status change

ApplicationInternalNote.title: ApplicationInternalNote
ApplicationInternalNote.description: Private recruiter/admin evaluation note under /applications/{applicationId}/internal_notes/{noteId}. Strictly forbidden to candidates.

InterviewSchedule.title: InterviewSchedule
InterviewSchedule.description: Scheduled job interview linked to a job application. Strictly readable by candidate, owning employer, and recruitment/super admins; writable only by owning employer or recruitment/super admins.

createdBy.description: Employer or admin UID who scheduled the interview

WebsiteContent.title: WebsiteContent
WebsiteContent.description: Website CMS content document (homepage sections, announcements, career guides, FAQs, policy pages). Publicly readable when status == 'published'; writable strictly by content_admin and super_admin.

body.description: Structured markdown or plain text content body

ctaUrl.description: Optional relative or HTTPS CTA URL

PublicSetting.title: PublicSetting
PublicSetting.description: Publicly readable non-secret platform configuration (social URLs, support email, feature display toggles). Strictly writable by content_admin and super_admin.

value.description: Bounded non-secret setting values map (max 25 keys)

HiringEnquiry.title: HiringEnquiry
HiringEnquiry.description: Employer hiring consultancy lead. Public create-only with status == 'New'; strictly unreadable publicly; managed by recruitment_admin, support_admin, and super_admin.

submittedByUid.description: Optional Firebase Auth UID if submitted while signed in

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last admin update

CourseEnquiry.title: CourseEnquiry
CourseEnquiry.description: Learn with ABHI training enquiry. Public create-only with status == 'New'; strictly unreadable publicly; managed by course_admin, support_admin, and super_admin.

submittedByUid.description: Optional Firebase Auth UID if signed in

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last admin update

CertificateApprovalRequest.title: CertificateApprovalRequest
CertificateApprovalRequest.description: Interim Starter-tier Admin-Approved Certificate Issuance request queue. Verified enrolled students submit pending requests; only course_admin or super_admin may approve or reject.

candidateName.description: Requested full name to appear on certificate

completedLessonsCount.description: Self-reported completed lessons snapshot (verified by admin against enrolment)

candidateNote.description: Optional candidate submission note or exercise summary

reviewedBy.description: Course/Super Admin UID who reviewed the request

reviewNote.description: Admin review feedback or rejection reason

/users/{userId}.description: User profile collection indexed by auth UID

/users/{userId}/career_assessments/{asse.description: Private per-candidate Job Seeker Profile Evaluation Test drafts and submitted reports

/users/{userId}/course_enrolments/{cours.description: Private per-candidate Learn with ABHI course enrolments, sequential unlock state, lesson progress, and completion state keyed by courseId

/users/{userId}/video_progress/{progress.description: Private per-candidate YouTube video playback tracking keyed by courseId__lessonId__videoId

/users/{userId}/assessment_attempts/{att.description: Private immutable per-candidate server-graded quiz and final assessment attempt records

/users/{userId}/certificates/{courseId}.description: Private per-candidate Course Completion Certificates keyed by courseId to prevent duplicates (supports preserved server_hmac and interim admin_approved issuance)

/users/{userId}/resumes/{resumeId}.description: Private per-candidate structured JSON resumes strictly readable and writable only by the owner

/users/{userId}/saved_jobs/{jobId}.description: Private per-user saved job bookmarks keyed by jobId

/users/{userId}/recently_viewed/{jobId}.description: Private per-user recently viewed job references keyed by jobId

/public_certificates/{certificateId}.description: Public single-document lookup registry for QR and ID certificate verification containing strictly minimal non-PII fields

/learning_courses/{courseId}.description: Admin-managed Learn with ABHI course metadata and publication status

/learning_courses/{courseId}/modules/{mo.description: Admin-managed ordered modules for a Learn with ABHI course

/learning_courses/{courseId}/lessons/{le.description: Admin-managed Learn with ABHI lesson content, YouTube video metadata, exercises, and downloadable attachments

/learning_courses/{courseId}/quiz_config.description: Admin-only quiz and final assessment definitions including answer keys and explanations

/certificate_templates/{templateId}.description: Admin-managed branding and layout templates for Course Completion Certificates

/certificate_requests/{requestId}.description: Admin-Approved Certificate Issuance review queue for Learn with ABHI on Starter tier

/admin_roles/{uid}.description: Authoritative 5-role RBAC registry keyed by Firebase Auth UID (super_admin, recruitment_admin, course_admin, content_admin, support_admin)

/admin_activity_logs/{logId}.description: Trusted server-written admin audit logs (browser writes strictly denied until Cloud Functions backend exists)

/platform_metrics/{metricId}.description: Admin-only platform metric snapshot documents supplementing Starter-tier getCountFromServer aggregations

/candidates/{uid}.description: Private candidate profiles containing PII and career details keyed by Firebase Auth UID

/candidate_directory/{uid}.description: Split-collection non-PII opt-in candidate discovery summaries readable strictly by verified employers and recruitment/super admins

/employers/{employerId}.description: Employer company profiles (publicly visible only when verificationStatus == 'verified'; recruiter PII excluded)

/employers/{employerId}/private_contacts.description: Split-collection private recruiter contact details and verification notes gated by parent employer ownership

/jobs/{jobId}.description: Job postings (publicly readable only when status == 'published'; zero candidate writes)

/applications/{applicationId}.description: Private job applications strictly scoped to applicant, owning employer, and recruitment/super admins

/applications/{applicationId}/internal_n.description: Private recruiter and admin application evaluation notes strictly isolated from candidates

/interviews/{interviewId}.description: Scheduled interviews linked to job applications (candidate read-only; owning employer and recruitment/super admins manage)

/website_content/{contentKey}.description: Website CMS blocks managed by content_admin and super_admin (publicly readable when published)

/public_settings/{settingKey}.description: Public non-secret site configuration managed by content_admin and super_admin

/hiring_enquiries/{enquiryId}.description: Employer hiring enquiries (public create-only with status == 'New'; admin read/manage only)

/course_enquiries/{enquiryId}.description: Learn with ABHI course enquiries (public create-only with status == 'New'; admin read/manage only)
